result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: it limits inspections to once in any rolling 12-month period, provides 30 days’ notice (more protective than the fallback’s 15 days), retains business-hours access, and keeps all inspection costs with HDI. It does not reach the preferred position because it permits HDI’s General Manager, rather than an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, to conduct the inspection and does not expressly prohibit direct systems access. The change is narrowly tailored and preserves the existing commercial intent, though the inherited phrase “may ... have the right” and comma placement are awkward.
